question_text: For what values of $c$ does the line $y = 2x + c$ never meet the parabola with equation $y = 3x^2 + 5x + 7$?

subparts.solution: Equating equations gives $3x^2 + 5x + 7 = 2x + c \implies 3x^2 + 3x + (7 - c) = 0$. No intersections requires $\Delta < 0 \implies 3^2 - 4(3)(7 - c) < 0 \implies 9 - 84 + 12c < 0 \implies 12c < 75 \implies c < \frac{25}{4}$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Two curves never intersect if the quadratic equation representing their intersection has no real roots ($\Delta < 0$).
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Sign error when expanding $-12(7-c)$ as $-84 - 12c$ instead of $-84 + 12c$.
